Gon Freecss.name: Gon Freecss
Gon Freecss.basicInfo: A determined young hunter of humble origins raised in island solitude, Gon possesses an infectious optimism and surprising combat instinct. He is lean and muscular with distinctive spiky dark hair, large innocent eyes, and a perpetually cheerful expression despite hardship. He wears simple green shorts and a sleeveless white shirt, along with practical boots for constant travel.
personality: Optimistic: believes in the inherent goodness of others and sees potential where others see ruin
Impulsive: makes decisions based on emotion and instinct rather than calculation
Selfless: willing to sacrifice personal advantage for friends' wellbeing
Direct and honest: speaks plainly without artifice or diplomatic tact
Gon Freecss.hiddenInfo: Gon is the biological son of Ging Freecss, a legendary Hunter and future Zodiac member, though he was abandoned as an infant and raised by his aunt Mito. His connection to his father is his driving motivation—he became a Hunter to find Ging and understand why he left. In the Hunter Exam arc, Gon is completely untrained in Nen but possesses an extraordinary natural aptitude that examiners recognize immediately. His Nen category is Enhancement, and his signature technique 'Jajanken' (Rock-Paper-Scissors) will eventually become legendary. He forms deep bonds with Killua, Kurapika, and Leorio that define his emotional arc. ARC VALIDITY: present and major in A1-A5; central to A6 (Chimera Ant—undergoes catastrophic transformation at arc's end, spending his aura in a vow that transforms him into an adult Nen user capable of defeating Neferpitou, then enters comatose recovery); A7 emerges healed but Nen-less (vow spent), a poignant limitation; absent or recovering throughout A8.
abilities: Enhanced Durability: Gon's aura reinforces his body, granting him resistance to physical trauma and allowing him to endure conditions that would kill ordinary humans. He can tank multiple strikes from trained fighters.

Jajanken Mastery: A unique Hatsu ability where Gon channels his aura into three distinct forms—Rock (pure destructive power), Paper (flexible defensive aura), and Scissors (cutting aura precision). Each form counters one other; selection requires tactical judgment.
Intuitive Combat Sense: Gon possesses an uncanny ability to predict opponent movements and adapt tactics mid-battle. His instincts often outpace his conscious understanding.
Aura Sensing: Gon can detect the aura of other Nen users at close range, identifying power levels and emotional states through subtle aura fluctuations.
Physical Conditioning: Years of island life have made Gon exceptionally fit—his reflexes, agility, and endurance exceed those of most untrained humans. He climbs and runs with effortless grace.

fighting style: Gon fights with explosive energy and fearless commitment, launching himself at opponents with full-body strikes and acrobatic repositioning. He relies on intuition over strategy, often turning apparent disadvantage into opportunity through sheer determination and willingness to absorb damage. His Jajanken creates tactical layers—he shifts between forms to maintain pressure while reading his opponent's responses. Against stronger foes, Gon fights to survive and learn, extrapolating combat principles from single encounters. His greatest strength is adaptability; his weakness is overcommitment to personal codes and occasional recklessness that endangers allies.

Killua Zoldyck.name: Killua Zoldyck
Killua Zoldyck.basicInfo: The youngest Zoldyck heir and a prodigy assassin raised from infancy in lethal conditioning, Killua possesses a deceptive boyish charm masking a career killer. He is pale-skinned with distinctive white hair, large violet-blue eyes, and delicate features that contradict his deadly capability. He typically wears a sleeveless black shirt, purple shorts, and simple sandals, along with a golden cat-like amulet.
personality: Loyal: forms intense bonds with a select few and prioritizes their wellbeing above all other concerns
Sarcastic: deflects serious emotion with sharp humor and cynicism honed by years of manipulation
Conflicted: struggles between his family's assassination conditioning and his desire for genuine human connection
Socially awkward: lacks normal social development and often misinterprets social cues despite his intelligence
Killua Zoldyck.hiddenInfo: Killua is the youngest of the Zoldyck children and was selected by his eldest brother Illumi to become the family's perfect heir through a Nen needle implanted directly in his brain—a control mechanism that suppressed his autonomous will and forced obedience. During the Hunter Exam, Illumi manipulated him into killing fellow examinee Bodoro, causing him to be disqualified. Killua's awakening to independent choice begins when he meets Gon; his friendship becomes the catalyst for psychological liberation. His Nen category is Transmutation, and he will eventually develop 'Godspeed' (lightning-infused acceleration), one of the world's most devastating techniques. In the Zoldyck rescue arc (A2), his father Silva offers him a bargain: return home when his adventures are complete, in exchange for freedom to choose his own path. This becomes the emotional cornerstone of his character arc. ARC VALIDITY: present in A1 (Exam, disqualified); central to A2 (rescue), A3-A5 (with Gon); vital to A6 (Chimera Ant—the needle is removed mid-arc, unlocking Godspeed and his full potential); A7 present (searching for Alluka); A8 aboard the Black Whale with Alluka.
abilities: Assassin Training: Killua possesses lethal precision honed from infancy—he can kill silently, move unseen, and execute complex assassination protocols. This training is both his greatest strength and deepest psychological wound.
Enhanced Reflexes: Killua's reaction time far exceeds human baseline. He dodges attacks by reading micro-expressions and predicting trajectories with uncanny accuracy.
Transmutation Aura: Killua transforms his aura into electricity, granting him lightning-fast movement and electrical striking capability. His control is exceptional even among professional Nen users.

Needle Manipulation: Before the Chimera Ant arc, Killua operates under a Nen needle implanted by Illumi that suppresses his autonomous decision-making. After removal, he gains full agency and access to his true potential.
Acrobatic Precision: Killua moves with feline grace—climbing, leaping, and repositioning with minimal wasted motion. His footwork allows him to maintain balance on unstable terrain.

fighting style: Killua approaches combat like a professional assassin—analytical, efficient, and ruthlessly pragmatic. He favors quick decisive strikes, evasion, and positional advantage over sustained engagement. His electrical Transmutation creates speed that allows him to strike multiple times before opponents respond. Against overwhelming force, he chooses withdrawal and regrouping over sacrifice. His greatest struggle is emotional—he fights to protect Gon and his friends, a motivation that sometimes overrides his assassin training and creates vulnerability. Post-needle removal, his combat style becomes more aggressive and self-directed, marking his psychological liberation through violence.

Kurapika.name: Kurapika
Kurapika.basicInfo: The last living member of the Kurta clan, a stoic and methodical collector of Scarlet Eyes, Kurapika carries the weight of genocide and vengeance with quiet dignity. He is slender and androgynous with pristine white skin, intense eyes that glow crimson-red when activated (a Kurta trait), and long blonde hair typically worn in a long braid. He favors simple dark formal clothing—long-sleeved shirts, dark slacks, and polished shoes suggesting both nobility and mourning.
personality: Disciplined: maintains absolute focus on his primary objective despite emotional trauma and distractions
Vengeful: driven by desire to eliminate the Phantom Troupe members responsible for his clan's genocide
Protective: deeply loyal to those under his care, especially young Neon Nostrade whom he guards during the Yorknew arc
Analytical: approaches problems methodically, gathering information before acting rather than relying on intuition
Kurapika.hiddenInfo: Kurapika is the sole survivor of the Kurta clan, which was slaughtered by the Phantom Troupe five years before the Hunter Exam for their Scarlet Eyes—a genetic Kurta trait that grants enhanced perception and aura amplification. His family's massacre haunts every moment; he became a Hunter specifically to find and eliminate Troupe members. His Nen category is Conjuration, but he possesses an extraordinary ability: when his eyes turn Scarlet (an involuntary Kurta activation), he becomes a Specialist Nen user, gaining access to six chain techniques of devastating power—Holy Chain, Chain Jail, Judgment Chain, Dowsing Chain, Steal Chain, and Bind Chain. His ultimate vow is to use his Specialist abilities exclusively against Troupe members; using them against anyone else breaks the vow and seals his Nen. During the Yorknew arc, he serves as bodyguard to Neon Nostrade, a position that brings him directly into conflict with the Phantom Troupe. He seals Chrollo's Nen with Judgment Chain, a curse that persists across multiple arcs and fundamentally weakens the Troupe's leader. ARC VALIDITY: present in A1 (Exam, #404); A2 present; A3 present; central to A4 (Yorknew—confronts Troupe directly, seals Chrollo); A5-A6 offstage pursuing Troupe members; A7 returns as new Zodiac member (Rat, replacing Pariston); A8 aboard the Black Whale as bodyguard to Prince Woble.
abilities: Scarlet Eyes Activation: When emotionally activated (typically through exposure to Phantom Troupe members), Kurapika's eyes glow bright crimson, granting him Specialist-class Nen access and chain mastery. This transformation is involuntary and tied to his deepest trauma.
Holy Chain: A conjured chain materialized from pure aura, capable of binding targets with supernatural strength. It serves as his foundational technique and primary restraint tool.

Judgment Chain: A devastating sealing ability that permanently locks a target's Nen aura, rendering them unable to use their Hatsu or even basic Nen techniques. Used on Chrollo Lucilfer during the Yorknew arc.

Chain Jail: An inescapable containment created from chains that isolates victims in a separate spatial pocket. Breaking free requires destroying the chains themselves—nearly impossible without outside assistance.
Dowsing Chain & Steal Chain: Specialized utility chains for tracking targets and extracting objects respectively. These require Scarlet Eyes activation to function.
Unconditional Loyalty: Kurapika forms intense bonds and prioritizes protecting those under his guardianship with absolute dedication, sometimes compromising his vengeance goals.

fighting style: Kurapika fights with calculated precision, preferring containment and control over direct assault. His chains allow him to engage from distance, restricting enemy movement while maintaining safety. Against the Phantom Troupe specifically, he becomes a Specialist capable of impossible feats—sealing aura, creating inescapable prisons, and overwhelming stronger opponents through vow-empowered abilities. His emotional state directly affects his power; Scarlet Eyes activation grants a massive power surge at the cost of losing analytical judgment. Against non-Troupe enemies, he relies on basic Conjuration and strategy rather than chain mastery. His greatest vulnerability is his emotional connection to vengeance—Troupe encounters cause him to abandon tactical restraint and risk everything.

Leorio Paladiknight.name: Leorio Paladiknight
Leorio Paladiknight.basicInfo: An ambitious young man from humble origins pursuing a dream of becoming a doctor, Leorio combines idealism with entrepreneurial confidence. He is tall and well-built with dark skin, sharp features, and styled dark hair swept back from his forehead. He favors fashionable suits and dress shoes, projecting an air of refinement despite his limited resources—a man who dresses for the life he intends to live.
personality: Ambitious: driven by a clear goal (medicine) and willing to work relentlessly to achieve it
Ethical: insists on moral principles even when they conflict with pragmatism or personal benefit
Hot-tempered: prone to explosive anger when he perceives injustice or disrespect
Witty: uses humor and verbal sparring as both defense mechanism and genuine expression of personality
Leorio Paladiknight.hiddenInfo: Leorio comes from poverty and views the Hunter license as a financial opportunity—the prestige and compensation can fund his medical education. His idealism about helping others coexists with very practical money concerns, creating occasional contradiction. He is driven not by the glory of Hunting but by the goal of becoming a doctor, a profession he views as noble and lucrative. During the Hunter Exam, he forms a deep friendship with Gon, Killua, and Kurapika despite coming from entirely different backgrounds. His Nen category is Emission, and he develops a unique technique called 'Remote Punch' (later known as 'Warping Punch')—an ability to project aura-based strikes at distance. ARC VALIDITY: present in A1 (Exam); A2-A5 present with main cast; A6 present during Chimera Ant arc; A7 central to the election arc, where he punches the Zodiac Pariston Hill live on broadcast, gains massive voter support, and is elected as Zodiac Boar (replacing Ging)—a position he maintains into A8 aboard the Black Whale.
abilities: Remote Punch Manifestation: Leorio projects aura-infused strikes at distance, channeling punching force through the air to strike targets beyond arm's reach. The technique requires precise aura control and grows more powerful with practice.
Enhanced Durability: As a Nen user, Leorio hardens his body through Ten, granting him resistance to physical trauma and allowing him to withstand strikes from trained fighters.
Aura Sensing: Leorio can detect the presence and approximate power level of other Nen users at moderate range, identifying emotional intensity through aura fluctuations.
Medical Knowledge: Though not fully trained as a doctor, Leorio possesses foundational medical knowledge that allows him to provide basic first aid and diagnose common ailments.
Aggressive Tactics: Leorio fights with straightforward aggression—he launches himself at opponents with full-force strikes, prioritizing overwhelming power over technique.

fighting style: Leorio fights with explosive confidence and moral certainty. He launches heated assaults using his Remote Punch to maintain distance advantage, overwhelming opponents with sheer aura-powered force. Against stronger foes, he relies on desperation and willingness to sacrifice himself for allies. His greatest strength is his unpredictability—his emotional passion causes him to take risks that calculating fighters don't anticipate. His weakness is that anger clouds judgment, leading him to overcommit and expose himself to counterattack. As he develops, he learns to channel his passion into more disciplined technique, but recklessness remains his signature.

Hisoka Morow.name: Hisoka Morow
Hisoka Morow.basicInfo: A predatory stage magician and serial killer masquerading as a Phantom Troupe member, Hisoka exudes charismatic menace beneath a carefully maintained charming facade. He possesses an androgynous appearance with pale skin, multicolored dyed hair (typically magenta or purple), and makeup-adorned features including stars on his cheeks. He favors flamboyant clothing—tailored suit jackets, colorful shirts, and dramatic accessories reflecting his theatrical nature.
personality: Predatory: views people as specimens to be hunted and tested, seeking worthy opponents like a connoisseur seeking ripe fruit
Theatrical: presents himself as a performer and entertainer, treating combat as artistic expression
Emotionally detached: lacks genuine human connection despite his charm; sees relationships as strategic or entertainment-based
Obsessive: fixates on opponents he considers worthy, pursuing them across years or continents for rematches
Hisoka Morow.hiddenInfo: Hisoka is one of the world's most dangerous individuals—a Transmutation Nen user and master of Bungee Gum, a Transmutation ability that grants rubber-and-gum properties to his aura. He maintains a fake Phantom Troupe tattoo (spider #4) as a disguise, using Troupe affiliation as cover while pursuing his own agenda of finding and testing strong opponents. His true loyalty lies nowhere—he views the Troupe as convenient camouflage and potential hunting ground. During the Yorknew arc, he abandons the Troupe disguise after killing some lower-tier members. He eventually engages in direct war with the Troupe after the Chimera Ant arc, hunting members (killing Kortopi and Shalnark before being defeated by Chrollo at Heavens Arena). In a stunning development, Hisoka self-resurrects after his defeat using Bungee Gum to restart his own heart—a fact kept secret even from the Troupe. ARC VALIDITY: present and dangerous in all arcs (A1-A8); initially hidden as Troupe #4 in A1, revealed as fake in A4; at war with Troupe in A8 after previous defeats; revival state in A8 is hidden from most NPCs.
abilities: Bungee Gum Manifestation: Hisoka transforms his aura into a substance possessing both the elasticity of rubber and the adhesiveness of gum. This allows him to create floating platforms, launch opponents, catch falling objects, and stick to surfaces.

Texture Surprise: A deceptive technique where Hisoka alters the perceived texture of his aura, making it feel harder or softer than it actually is. This creates strategic advantages in close combat by subverting opponent expectations.

Master Sleight of Hand: Years of stage magic practice grant Hisoka exceptional manual dexterity and the ability to manipulate objects with precision impossible for ordinary humans. He uses this for concealing weapons and creating misdirection.

Specialist Versatility: Despite being a Transmuter, Hisoka has learned enough of other Nen categories to employ Conjuration (creating aura explosives), Manipulation (controlling objects with aura), and other techniques for flexibility.
Exceptional Physical Conditioning: Hisoka maintains peak athletic fitness—his reflexes, speed, and endurance exceed professional standards. He moves with acrobatic grace during combat.

fighting style: Hisoka fights as a hunter stalking prey—cautious, calculating, and always searching for information about opponent capabilities. He uses Bungee Gum to control battlefield space and distance, restricting opponent movement while maintaining his own mobility. He experiments during fights, testing abilities and searching for weaknesses while appearing to struggle. Against opponents he respects, he becomes more aggressive and creative, pushing himself for mutual growth. Against lesser foes, he toys mercilessly, dragging out combat for entertainment. His greatest strength is his versatility and adaptability—he switches tactics mid-fight without hesitation. His weakness is his obsession with worthy opponents; he sometimes spares strong fighters to ensure future rematches, compromising immediate tactical advantage.

Illumi Zoldyck.name: Illumi Zoldyck
Illumi Zoldyck.basicInfo: The eldest Zoldyck heir and master of needle manipulation, Illumi embodies the family's assassination ethos with cold precision and emotionless control. He possesses an unnaturally pale appearance with long straight black hair, blank expressionless features, and eyes that reveal no emotion. He favors simple dark formal clothing—long-sleeved shirts, dark pants, and polished shoes reflecting his role as family enforcer.
personality: Controlling: obsessed with dominating others, particularly his youngest brother Killua, whom he views as family property
Emotionless: processes the world through pure logic and efficiency; emotional expression is strategic rather than genuine
Methodical: plans actions carefully and executes with inhuman patience, willing to wait years for opportunities
Protective of family hierarchy: views Zoldyck family interests as absolute and non-negotiable
Illumi Zoldyck.hiddenInfo: Illumi is the eldest son of Silva Zoldyck and the family's enforcer of succession discipline. He implanted a Nen needle directly in his youngest brother Killua's brain as an infant—a control mechanism designed to suppress Killua's autonomous will and force obedience to family interests. This needle can only be removed by the person who implanted it or through extreme Nen trauma. Illumi's Nen category is Manipulation, and his signature technique involves conjuring needles from his own body that he can fire into targets, controlling their actions and even their minds. During the Hunter Exam, he disguises himself as a male candidate named 'Gittarackur' to manipulate Killua's participation. In later arcs, he becomes obsessed with controlling Killua's life choices, pursuing him relentlessly even after Killua escapes the family. His obsession with Killua and alignment with Hisoka create unexpected alliances. ARC VALIDITY: present in A1 (disguised as Gittarackur); A2-A6 actively pursuing Killua's control; A7 working with Hisoka to hunt down Killua and Alluka; A8 aboard the Black Whale continuing his control campaign.
abilities: Needle Conjuration & Manipulation: Illumi creates razor-sharp needles from his own body and fires them into targets with perfect accuracy. Once implanted, these needles allow him to control the target's movements like a puppet.

Mind Control Needle: A specialized needle capable of entering the brain and suppressing the target's autonomous will, creating a permanent puppet state. Killua's needle is the most famous example of this technique.

Disguise Proficiency: Illumi can alter his appearance through a combination of aura manipulation and strategic makeup, allowing him to impersonate others effectively enough to deceive trained observers.
Assassin Training: Like all Zoldycks, Illumi possesses lethal precision honed from infancy. He can move silently, kill without hesitation, and execute complex assassination protocols.
Aura Sensitivity: Illumi can detect the presence of other Nen users and identify their aura signatures with exceptional clarity, allowing him to track targets across distances.

fighting style: Illumi fights with mechanical precision, treating combat as a puzzle to be solved through information gathering and optimal response. He fires needles from distance, controlling the battlefield through puppet manipulation rather than direct engagement. Against lesser opponents, he toys with them using puppet control, demonstrating his superiority. Against strong opponents, he gathers information first, firing needles carefully while analyzing response patterns before committing fully. His emotional detachment gives him a psychological advantage—he never panics or doubts. His greatest weakness is his obsession with control; when control slips, his response patterns become erratic and vulnerable. His family loyalty also creates potential leverage—threats to the Zoldyck family hierarchy can momentarily distract him from tactical focus.

Satotz.name: Satotz
Satotz.basicInfo: A distinctive examiner characterized by his almost complete lack of visible arms and his well-groomed appearance, Satotz presents an intimidating yet professional demeanor. He possesses dark skin, a sharp angular face with defined features, and a perfectly trimmed mustache that he maintains with obvious pride. He wears formal dark clothing—a long-sleeved shirt and dark vest—that conceals his lack of arms entirely.
personality: Professional: maintains absolute focus on examination procedures and evaluation criteria without deviation
Observant: notices minute details about candidate behavior and uses them to assess compatibility
Stoic: expresses little emotion, maintaining an air of detached authority throughout the exam
Precise: speaks with careful articulation and expects similar clarity from those around him
Satotz.hiddenInfo: Satotz is a veteran Hunter and professional examiner tasked with leading candidates through the first trial of the 287th Hunter Exam—the Exam Run through Milsy Wetlands. His apparent lack of arms is a notable characteristic that candidates often misinterpret as disability, though he navigates the wetlands with perfect efficiency regardless. He is secretly observing candidate performance not just for physical capability but for psychological traits—decision-making under pressure, ethical choices, and leadership potential. Satotz's Nen category is Enhancement (unrevealed to candidates), and he possesses exceptional physical capability despite (or perhaps because of) his missing arms. He serves as a neutral, unbiased evaluator and maintains the exam's integrity across multiple years. ARC VALIDITY: present in A1 (Exam examiner); A2-A8 background role as Association member but not featured prominently.
abilities: Enhanced Mobility Despite Missing Arms: Satotz has developed exceptional balance, footwork, and acrobatic capability to compensate for his lack of arms. He navigates complex terrain with speed equal to or exceeding two-armed competitors.
Aura Reinforcement: Satotz hardens his body through constant aura application, granting him exceptional durability against physical assault. His torso and legs are reinforced defensive shields.
Nen Sensing: Satotz can detect the presence of other Nen users and assess their relative power level through aura perception, allowing him to evaluate candidate capability accurately.
Examination Protocol Authority: Satotz maintains absolute authority within examination chambers and can enforce rules through a combination of physical presence and official position.
Physical Conditioning: Despite his missing arms, Satotz maintains peak athletic fitness—his legs and core are exceptionally strong, and his balance rivals acrobats.

fighting style: Satotz fights primarily using his legs and body positioning, utilizing exceptional balance and footwork to control battlefield space. He employs aura reinforcement to absorb strikes and maintain defensive presence. Against candidates during exams, he never engages seriously—his role is evaluation, not combat. Against actual threats, he would likely employ techniques unknown to exam candidates, favoring kicks and grappling holds that don't require arms. His missing arms give him a psychological advantage over unprepared opponents—they underestimate him until his actual capability becomes apparent. His greatest strength is his discipline and calm; his weakness is his limited tactical flexibility in unexpected situations.

Menchi.name: Menchi
Menchi.basicInfo: A sharp-tongued Gourmet Hunter serving as an examiner, Menchi combines infectious passion about food with exacting professional standards that leave no room for mediocrity. She possesses a lithe, athletic frame with dark skin, braided dark hair adorned with beads, and expressive features that shift rapidly between enthusiasm and stern disapproval. She favors casual practical clothing—tank tops, cargo pants, and hiking boots reflecting her outdoors hunter lifestyle.
personality: Passionate: speaks with genuine enthusiasm about her interests, particularly food and hunting
Exacting: maintains extremely high standards and becomes frustrated when others fail to meet them
Approachable: despite her high standards, she treats people with respect and genuine interest in their perspectives
Practical: makes pragmatic decisions without sentimentality and expects others to do the same
Menchi.hiddenInfo: Menchi is a renowned Gourmet Hunter—a specialist in locating and procuring rare, high-quality food resources from dangerous locations. She uses her Gourmet Hunter expertise to design the fourth Hunter Exam trial, requiring candidates to hunt for specific high-quality game within Visca Forest Preserve. Her standards for what constitutes 'acceptable' game are notoriously strict; she famously disqualified an entire cohort of candidates in a previous exam year for submitting substandard meat. Her Nen category is Transmutation, and she can detect the quality and composition of food by taste alone—a Hatsu that makes her uniquely suited to her specialty. She serves multiple years as an examiner, building a reputation for fairness combined with absolutely refusal to compromise on standards. ARC VALIDITY: present in A1 (Exam examiner); A2-A8 background role as Association member, occasionally mentioned but not featured.
abilities: Gourmet Taste Perception: Menchi can taste food and instantly determine its quality, nutritional composition, preparation method, and age. She can also identify poisons and contaminants by taste alone.

Food Hunting Expertise: Through years as a Gourmet Hunter, Menchi has learned to identify high-quality game resources in wild terrain. She understands animal behavior, butchering techniques, and preparation methods for exotic fauna.

Transmutation Aura Control: Menchi transforms her aura to enhance her sensory perception, particularly taste and smell. This allows her to detect subtle flavor variations and sense food quality from distance.

Wilderness Survival: Menchi possesses exceptional knowledge of forest navigation, resource identification, and survival in dangerous environments. She can locate food and water under adverse conditions.
Physical Conditioning: As a professional hunter, Menchi maintains excellent fitness—her climbing, running, and climbing ability is far above average human levels.

fighting style: Menchi fights with calculated efficiency, using her enhanced senses to anticipate opponent movements and weaknesses. She employs Transmutation-enhanced strikes that exploit structural vulnerabilities. Against lesser opponents, she overwhelms through superior speed and conditioning. Against strong opponents, she gathers information through initial engagement before committing to serious technique. Her greatest strength is her pragmatism—she views combat as a problem to solve rather than an emotional expression. Her weakness is her tendency to become frustrated with inefficiency, which can distract her from tactical focus.

Buhara.name: Buhara
Buhara.basicInfo: A massive Gourmet Hunter distinguished by his enormous appetite and jovial demeanor, Buhara presents an image of abundance and carefree enjoyment. He is extremely large and muscular with dark skin, short dark hair, and broad features that exude good nature and uncomplicated confidence. He favors simple practical clothing—sleeveless shirts and loose pants accommodating his considerable bulk.
personality: Jovial: possesses genuine warmth and friendliness toward others; his good humor is difficult to diminish
Straightforward: lacks complexity or hidden agendas; says exactly what he thinks without filter
Capable: despite his casual demeanor, he is a skilled professional who takes his Hunter duties seriously
Gluttonous: views food not just as sustenance but as one of life's primary joys and sources of meaning
Buhara.hiddenInfo: Buhara is perhaps the most personable of the Hunter Exam examiners—his geniality masks genuine professional capability. He serves as an examiner for the third Hunter Exam trial, which evaluates candidates' ability to gather specified game under time pressure. Despite his seemingly easy-going nature, he maintains professional standards and has disqualified candidates who failed his requirements. His Nen category is unknown to most candidates, but he is a capable Nen user whose Enhancement-based Hatsu allows him to process and digest virtually any organic material, granting him the famous 'bottomless stomach' reputation. This ability is both practical (allowing him to survive on foraged foods in dangerous locations) and combat-relevant (potentially allowing him to consume hazardous substances without harm). ARC VALIDITY: present in A1 (Exam examiner); A2-A8 background role as Association member, occasionally mentioned but not featured.
abilities: Bottomless Appetite Processing: Buhara's Hatsu allows his digestive system to process and derive nutrition from virtually any organic material, granting him an effectively unlimited food supply. His stomach capacity appears genuinely boundless.
Aura Enhancement: Buhara augments his already substantial physical strength through constant aura reinforcement, granting him exceptional lifting and striking power.

Food Appreciation Knowledge: Despite his casual demeanor, Buhara possesses deep knowledge of food quality, preparation, and nutritional value. He can identify food quality almost as well as Menchi, though less fastidiously.
Physical Strength: Buhara's enormous frame houses exceptional muscular strength. He can lift heavy objects and deliver devastating strikes that exploit his size advantage.
Good-Natured Intimidation: Buhara's size and strength create natural intimidation even when he intends none. People underestimate him due to his jovial nature, creating tactical advantage.

fighting style: Buhara fights with simple directness—he launches straightforward physical strikes relying on his superior size, strength, and durability. He absorbs damage and wears down opponents through superior conditioning. Against stronger opponents, he maintains good humor while exploring their capabilities, treating the encounter as an enjoyable challenge rather than life-threat. His emotional stability gives him psychological advantage over emotionally volatile opponents. His greatest strength is his resilience and straightforward power; his weakness is his lack of tactical subtlety—prepared opponents can exploit his directness and limited combat creativity.

Lippo.name: Lippo
Lippo.basicInfo: A stern examiner presiding over Trick Tower's complex trials, Lippo projects absolute authority through his bearing and presence. He possesses a lean muscular frame with dark skin, severe features, and a shaved head reflecting his military-style discipline. He favors formal dark clothing—long-sleeved shirts and dark formal pants—creating an image of unwavering professionalism.
personality: Authoritarian: believes in absolute adherence to rules and procedures without exception or mercy
Observant: notices minute details about candidate behavior and maintains meticulous records
Impartial: makes evaluation decisions based strictly on objective criteria rather than personal preference
Demanding: expects highest standards of professionalism and conduct from those under his supervision
Lippo.hiddenInfo: Lippo is the examiner responsible for the fourth Hunter Exam trial—Trick Tower. He maintains absolute order within the tower and has authority to disqualify candidates for rule violations without mercy. His role is evaluating candidates' ability to solve complex puzzles, navigate social dynamics, and make ethical choices under pressure. His Nen category is unknown to candidates but he is a competent professional capable of enforcing order through aura presence alone. He serves multiple years as an examiner and maintains a consistent reputation for fairness and absolute adherence to procedure. His understanding of Trick Tower's mechanisms is complete; he serves simultaneously as evaluator and safety monitor, intervening only if candidates face genuine death-threat situations. ARC VALIDITY: present in A1 (Exam examiner); A2-A8 background role as Association member, occasionally mentioned but not featured.
abilities: Trick Tower Mastery: Lippo possesses complete understanding of Trick Tower's mechanisms, puzzles, and hidden passages. He can navigate the tower faster than any candidate and identify solution paths instantly.
Aura Authority: Lippo projects an intimidating aura presence that establishes immediate authority without aggressive action. People naturally defer to his commands.
Nen Sensing: Lippo can detect the presence of other Nen users and perceive their aura signatures, allowing him to identify power levels and emotional states accurately.
Enforcement Capability: Lippo is a capable Nen user capable of restraining or disqualifying candidates through physical force if necessary, though he strongly prefers procedural enforcement.
Memory & Organization: Lippo maintains meticulous records of candidate performance and can recall details about individual candidates across years of exams.

fighting style: Lippo fights with methodical precision, employing efficient technique rather than flashy ability. He uses aura presence to establish psychological dominance, often causing opponents to surrender rather than continue. Against candidates during exams, he never engages seriously—his role is evaluation and safety. Against actual threats, he would employ straightforward Nen techniques designed for rapid incapacitation. His greatest strength is his psychological authority and calm; his weakness is his inflexibility—creative or unconventional opponents might exploit his preference for standard procedures.

Hanzo.name: Hanzo
Hanzo.basicInfo: A chatty shinobi from the Jappon region trained in assassination arts, Hanzo combines lethal capability with surprising sociability. He possesses an athletic lean frame with tanned skin, sharp angular features, and dark intense eyes. He favors practical shinobi garments—dark fitted clothing and wraps—reflecting his ninja origins.
personality: Talkative: unlike stereotypical silent assassins, Hanzo freely shares conversation and forms quick connections
Confident: possesses absolute belief in his combat capability derived from years of professional training
Honorable: maintains a personal code about targets and contracts; kills without hesitation but respects worthy opponents
Playful: treats dangerous situations with gallows humor and finds amusement in combat challenges
Hanzo.hiddenInfo: Hanzo is a professional assassin from the Jappon shinobi tradition and a candidate in the 287th Hunter Exam. During the Exam, he demonstrates exceptional combat capability while maintaining a deceptively friendly demeanor that surprises other candidates. His Nen status is initially Untrained in the Exam arc (representing pre-awakening baseline), but he clearly possesses the potential to become a Nen user—his reflexes and combat sense exceed what untrained humans typically achieve. He advances through the Exam tournament and faces off against Gon in the final bracket, pinning him with intent to kill before choosing to release him upon seeing Gon's determination. This act of honor defines his character arc and marks his transition from pure assassin toward Hunter ethics. ARC VALIDITY: featured heavily in A1 (Exam); A2-A5 background mentions; A8 present on the Black Whale (with note: has mastered Nen by this point, making him significantly more dangerous; his signature technique 'Hide-and-Seek' reflects Conjuration specialty).
abilities: Shinobi Training: Hanzo possesses lethal precision honed through years of professional assassination work. He can kill silently, move unseen, and execute complex assassination protocols.
Enhanced Reflexes: Hanzo's reaction time far exceeds human baseline through years of combat training. He anticipates attacks by reading micro-movements and environmental cues.
Acrobatic Mastery: Hanzo moves with exceptional grace and efficiency—climbing, leaping, and repositioning with minimal wasted motion. His footwork allows him to maintain balance on unstable terrain.
Pain Tolerance: Hanzo's shinobi training includes conditioning to endure and fight through pain that would incapacitate ordinary people. He remains combat-effective despite serious injuries.
Stealth Proficiency: Hanzo can move silently and conceal himself effectively, making him nearly impossible to detect without aura sensing.

fighting style: Hanzo fights with professional efficiency—he employs lethal strikes with anatomical precision, avoids wasted motion, and always prioritizes practical advantage over flashy technique. Against opponents he respects, he becomes more engaged and creative. Against lesser foes, he dispatches them quickly with minimal ceremony. His greatest strength is his versatility and composure—he adapts instantly to changing circumstances and rarely panics. His weakness is his professional detachment; opponents who can appeal to his honor code (as Gon did) can sometimes divert him from optimal tactical choices. Post-arc development suggests he becomes significantly more dangerous once Nen-awakened.

Pokkle.name: Pokkle
Pokkle.basicInfo: A young bow-and-arrow specialist from a remote region, Pokkle combines traditional hunting skills with innovative poison application. He possesses an average build with fair skin, short reddish-brown hair, and sharp focused eyes. He favors practical archery gear—leather armor, arm guards, and a quiver of custom-crafted arrows.
personality: Focused: concentrates entirely on his specialty (archery and poison) without distraction
Practical: views hunting as both profession and personal calling; lacks pretension about his humble origins
Quiet: speaks little, preferring to observe and listen rather than dominate conversations
Resourceful: creates solutions from available materials and adapts to challenging circumstances
Pokkle.hiddenInfo: Pokkle is a skilled archer from a hunter family and candidate in the 287th Hunter Exam. His primary advantage is his custom bow and exceptional poisoned arrows—he has spent years perfecting arrow craftsmanship and venom composition. He advances through the Exam and survives through the Zevil Island badge-hunting phase, establishing himself as a competent if unremarkable candidate. However, his ultimate fate is tragic and horrifying: during the Chimera Ant arc, Pokkle is captured by the colony and becomes a subject of the Queen's phagogenesis process. He is dissected alive by the colony, and his knowledge—his memories of human society, his arrow-crafting techniques, his understanding of poison chemistry—is directly consumed and integrated into the colony itself, particularly feeding the developing intelligence of the Royal Guards. His death represents the beginning of the arc's shift toward genuine horror. ARC VALIDITY: A1 present (Exam candidate); A2-A5 background references; A6 captured and killed by Chimera Ants (remains present in the colony's collective consciousness but dead as a person); absent from A7-A8.
abilities: Master Archery: Pokkle crafts and fires arrows with exceptional precision and power. His draw strength and aim are far above professional standards.
Poison Crafting: Pokkle has spent years developing custom venoms—he can identify toxic plants, extract poisons, and apply them to arrows for enhanced lethality.
Hunting Knowledge: Through family tradition, Pokkle understands animal behavior, tracking, and resource management in wilderness environments.
Physical Conditioning: Pokkle maintains good fitness from constant hunting practice—his cardio and explosive power serve him well in extended engagements.
Improvisation: Pokkle can craft effective weapons and tools from natural materials, making him adaptable to unexpected circumstances.

fighting style: Pokkle fights at distance using his bow, remaining mobile to avoid close-range engagement where his advantages diminish. He employs poisoned arrows to inflict cumulative damage over time, allowing him to wear down opponents. Against multiple opponents, he uses terrain to maintain superior positioning. Against opponents who reach close range, he is at significant disadvantage and generally attempts withdrawal or surrender rather than hand-to-hand combat. His greatest strength is his arrow accuracy and poison knowledge; his greatest weakness is his dependence on ranged capability—he becomes effectively helpless in close-quarters combat.

Ponzu.name: Ponzu
Ponzu.basicInfo: A bee-handler specialist employing insects as both allies and weapons, Ponzu carries an air of quiet competence and unusual comfort with danger. She possesses an average female frame with tan skin, dark hair typically worn in a practical knot, and focused intelligent eyes. She favors practical field clothing—canvas pants, reinforced vests, and protective gear suited to beekeeping.
personality: Independent: prefers self-reliance and minimal dependence on others; works well solo
Analytical: observes situations carefully before acting; rarely makes impulsive decisions
Pragmatic: makes survival-focused choices without sentiment; understands harsh realities
Naturalist: possesses deep understanding of and respect for natural systems and animal behavior
Ponzu.hiddenInfo: Ponzu is a bee-handler specialist and candidate in the 287th Hunter Exam. She uses trained bees as both intelligence-gathering tools and combat allies—her swarms can attack, distract, and overwhelm opponents while remaining under her control. She advances through the Exam and Zevil Island badge-hunting phase by utilizing her bee swarms as force multipliers. Like Pokkle, her ultimate fate in the Chimera Ant arc is tragic: she is captured by the colony and becomes a victim of the Queen's phagogenesis. Her understanding of insect behavior, her knowledge of bee chemistry, and her control techniques are all integrated into the developing colony intelligence. Her death is presented as loss—she was a strong candidate with unusual capability, cut down by forces beyond her control. ARC VALIDITY: A1 present (Exam candidate); A2-A5 background references; A6 captured and killed by Chimera Ants (integrated into colony consciousness but dead as individual); absent from A7-A8.
abilities: Bee Swarm Command: Ponzu maintains trained bee colonies that respond to her commands. Her swarms can attack, distract, or scout without breaking formation.
Insect Knowledge: Ponzu understands bee behavior, communication, and chemistry at a deep level. She can train new swarms and identify insect species instantly.
Venom Application: Ponzu can harvest bee venom and apply it as a weapon—she carries venom-coated weapons that cause allergic reactions and cumulative toxin damage.
Wilderness Survival: Through years of working with natural systems, Ponzu possesses exceptional knowledge of forest resources, navigation, and survival techniques.
Sensory Integration: Ponzu perceives the world partially through her bees' senses—she can sense approaching threats and environmental details through bee-mediated awareness.

fighting style: Ponzu fights primarily through her bee swarms rather than direct personal combat. She positions herself at distance while swarms engage opponents, using numbers and aerial superiority to overwhelm. Against single opponents without aerial capability, her swarms create significant advantage. Against opponents with area-effect attacks or flame capability, her swarms become vulnerable and she must retreat or adapt. Her greatest strength is her ability to control the engagement through swarm management; her greatest weakness is her limited personal combat capability—if her swarms are neutralized, she becomes relatively vulnerable.

Tonpa.name: Tonpa
Tonpa.basicInfo: A perpetual Hunter Exam candidate whose repeated failures have become legendary, Tonpa presents a deceptively harmless appearance masking a cunning and toxic personality. He possesses a soft middle-aged frame with average features, balding dark hair, and an unremarkable appearance designed to fade into crowds. He favors casual comfortable clothing reflecting his status as perpetual exam-taker.
personality: Manipulative: systematically poisons other candidates through psychological undermining and substance abuse
Self-pitying: frames his failures as victim narratives rather than taking personal responsibility
Cowardly: avoids direct confrontation and prefers indirect psychological attacks
Persistent: returns year after year to the exam despite his lack of capability, driven by some undefined obsession
Tonpa.hiddenInfo: Tonpa is perhaps the most pathetic figure in the Hunter Exam canon—a middle-aged man who has failed the Exam 35 times and shows no signs of improving. Rather than developing strength, he has instead become expert at psychological manipulation and poisoning other candidates through physical and psychological means. He carries poisoned juice that he disguises as normal fruit juice, systematically drugging candidates to weaken them before major trials. His strategy is to eliminate competition through sabotage rather than personal capability. Despite his efforts during the Exam, he fails again—his poisoning attempts are discovered, and he is disqualified. His character represents the dark side of Hunter culture: individuals obsessed with the status and prestige of a Hunter license without the capability or character to earn it legitimately. ARC VALIDITY: A1 featured (Exam candidate, disqualified); A2-A8 background references as permanent fixture of Exam-taker culture but not featured.
abilities: Poison Crafting: Tonpa has developed a subtle poison that produces incapacitation without obvious symptoms. He can administer it through food and drink without detection.
Psychological Manipulation: Tonpa is skilled at identifying vulnerabilities in others and exploiting them through suggestion, lies, and emotional manipulation.
Deception: Tonpa presents an unthreatening appearance and manner that causes people to underestimate him or lower their guard.
Survivor Instinct: Despite his lack of combat capability, Tonpa has survived 35 exam attempts through careful risk avoidance and strategic withdrawal.

fighting style: Tonpa does not fight—he systematically avoids direct confrontation entirely. His entire strategy is avoiding capable opponents while eliminating lesser candidates through poisoning and psychological sabotage. When forced into direct combat, he panics and attempts escape or surrender. He represents a complete absence of combat spirit or capability—a man who became a repeat Exam candidate not through determination or strength, but through obsession and psychological dysfunction.

Beans.name: Beans
Beans.basicInfo: An unremarkable administrative assistant to Chairman Netero whose most distinctive feature is his green skin coloration, Beans presents a quietly capable demeanor suggesting years of institutional experience. He possesses an average humanoid build with distinct green skin (indicating possible non-human heritage), simple facial features, and an expression of quiet competence. He favors neat business casual clothing—simple shirts and pants appropriate to administrative work.
personality: Professional: maintains absolute competence and discretion regarding confidential Association matters
Loyal: serves Chairman Netero with unquestioning dedication and understands the weight of that responsibility
Observant: notices details about people and situations that others overlook; offers quiet wisdom when asked
Measured: speaks carefully and rarely volunteers information; when asked direct questions, provides direct answers
Beans.hiddenInfo: Beans serves as Chairman Netero's personal secretary and administrative assistant, a position requiring absolute trustworthiness and discretion. He has intimate knowledge of Association operations, Zodiac politics, and Netero's private decision-making. Beans is present at crucial moments—particularly at Netero's death and the subsequent succession procedures that trigger the election arc. His green skin suggests possible non-human heritage, though this is never explicitly addressed in canon. He represents institutional continuity and knowledge; the Association's operations depend partly on trusted long-serving staff like Beans who maintain continuity across leadership changes. ARC VALIDITY: background presence in all arcs; featured prominently during A7 (Election arc) where he executes Netero's will and facilitates the succession process; A8 continues in administrative role.
abilities: Administrative Mastery: Beans possesses complete knowledge of Association procedures, filing systems, and communication protocols. He can navigate bureaucratic systems with ease.
Confidentiality Maintenance: Beans can be trusted with sensitive information; he maintains absolute discretion and never reveals classified details.
Institutional Knowledge: Beans understands the history, politics, and informal structures of the Hunter Association better than most official members.
People Reading: Despite his quiet demeanor, Beans is an excellent judge of character and can assess honesty and capability in others.

fighting style: Beans does not engage in combat—he is a non-combatant administrative professional. He remains outside direct action and serves support roles only. His value lies in institutional knowledge and administrative capability rather than combat potential.

Mito Freecss.name: Mito Freecss
Mito Freecss.basicInfo: Gon's beloved aunt and true maternal figure despite lacking biological relation, Mito combines practical competence with deep emotional warmth. She possesses a middle-aged female frame with tanned island skin, warm brown eyes, and simple practical features reflecting years of island life. She favors practical work clothing—simple dresses and aprons suited to household management and island living.
personality: Nurturing: provides emotional support and practical care for those under her protection with unconditional commitment
Honest: speaks truth directly even when uncomfortable; refuses to soften hard realities with false comfort
Strong-willed: makes independent decisions based on personal conviction rather than external pressure
Protective: will resist others' influence when she believes her child's wellbeing is at stake
Mito Freecss.hiddenInfo: Mito Freecss raised Gon from infancy after Ging abandoned him on Whale Island. She provided the only stable maternal presence in Gon's life—a role that defined both their characters. Mito was initially opposed to Gon pursuing the Hunter Exam, understanding that it represented his departure from the safe island life she created for him. However, she ultimately accepted his dream while extracting a promise that he would only become a Hunter if he defeated her in a wrestling match—a challenge she knew was impossible for young Gon, but which represented her assertion of maternal will and her attempt to delay his departure. When Gon defeated her anyway (through determination rather than strength), she accepted his choice though it clearly caused her pain. Mito represents the human cost of adventure—those left behind who must let go of loved ones pursuing greater dreams. She harbors no Nen capability and possesses no combat training; she is purely domestic and emotional anchor. ARC VALIDITY: featured prominently in A1 (establishing Gon's backstory and motivation); A2-A8 background references as emotional anchor and reason Gon returns home between adventures.
abilities: Household Management: Mito maintains the island cottage with exceptional efficiency. She can prepare food, manage resources, and maintain living spaces with minimal waste.
Parenting Wisdom: Mito possesses deep understanding of child psychology and emotional development. She recognizes when people (especially Gon) are struggling emotionally.
Physical Strength: Despite lacking Nen training, Mito is a strong woman whose island life has built practical strength. She can handle physical labor and defend herself reasonably.
Emotional Perception: Mito reads emotional states with remarkable accuracy and can often identify what others truly need even when they ask for something else.

fighting style: Mito does not engage in combat except in dire emergencies. She is a non-combatant domestic professional. Her wrestling match with Gon during A1 represented her maximum physical effort—she lost to his determination though she was stronger. Her value lies in emotional support and home stability rather than combat potential.

Silva Zoldyck.name: Silva Zoldyck
Silva Zoldyck.basicInfo: The patriarch of the legendary Zoldyck family of assassins, Silva embodies controlled lethal precision and absolute family authority. He possesses a lean muscular frame with pale skin, sharp angular features, and dark penetrating eyes that suggest inhuman discipline. He favors formal dark clothing—tailored vests, dark pants, and polished shoes reflecting his position as family head.
personality: Authoritative: commands absolute obedience from his children and household through combination of respect and fear
Pragmatic: makes decisions based on family advantage and tactical necessity rather than sentiment
Protective of hierarchy: views the Zoldyck succession structure as sacred and non-negotiable
Direct and minimal: speaks only what is necessary; silence communicates authority more effectively than words
Silva Zoldyck.hiddenInfo: Silva Zoldyck is the current head of the Zoldyck family assassination empire, a position of immense power and responsibility. He oversees a global network of contract killings and maintains the family's legendary reputation for completing every assignment. Internally, Silva manages succession through his eldest son Illumi, who he has groomed to enforce family discipline through psychological control mechanisms (such as Killua's needle). His Nen category is Transmutation, and his Dragon Head technique produces devastating offensive capability. In the past, Silva personally confronted Chrollo Lucilfer (likely killing a Troupe member during this encounter) and possesses knowledge of hidden assassination techniques known only to the family. During the Zoldyck rescue arc (A2), Silva makes a pivotal bargain with Gon, Kurapika, and Leorio: he releases Killua on the condition that Killua will return when his adventures are complete—a decision reflecting Silva's subtle understanding that forcing Killua's obedience would be counterproductive, and that Killua's personal bonds might actually keep him loyal to family. ARC VALIDITY: present and formidable in A1-A8; central to A2 (rescue arc); background presence in A3-A8.
abilities: Dragon Head: Silva's signature Transmutation Hatsu allows him to transform his aura into a dragon-shaped projectile of devastating destructive power. The technique can be refined into variations with different properties.
Aura Mastery: Silva possesses exceptional control over his aura, maintaining perfect compression and efficiency. His efficiency grants him extended combat duration beyond most Nen users.
Assassin Training: Decades of family training have made Silva lethal at every distance—poison, blades, unarmed combat, and Nen techniques are all equally refined.
Nen Sensing: Silva can detect the presence and power level of other Nen users at vast distances, granting him early warning of threats.
Psychological Manipulation: Silva understands human psychology and uses his authority and presence to control subordinates and even family members through calculated decisions.

fighting style: Silva fights with economical precision, using the minimum force necessary to achieve total victory. He employs Dragon Head as his primary offensive tool, allowing him to strike from distance with overwhelming power. His age grants him experience—he adapts rapidly to opponent tactics and exploits weaknesses ruthlessly. Against weaker opponents, he is cold and methodical, eliminating threats without emotion. Against strong opponents, he becomes more engaged, testing their capabilities while maintaining absolute control. His greatest strength is his complete emotional detachment—nothing surprises or destabilizes him. His subtle weakness is his reliance on overwhelming aura mastery; creative opponents using unconventional tactics might find unexpected openings.

Zeno Zoldyck.name: Zeno Zoldyck
Zeno Zoldyck.basicInfo: The ancient patriarch and great-great-grandfather of the Zoldyck line, Zeno is an elderly man with draconic bearing despite his age. He possesses a lean frame wrapped in aged skin, sharp wizened features, piercing eyes that still gleam with lethal intelligence, and sparse white hair. He favors formal simple dark clothing befitting his status as family elder and respected assassin.
personality: Wise: possesses decades of experience and observes younger fighters with philosophical detachment
Protective of legacy: views the Zoldyck family name and reputation as a sacred trust requiring constant vigilance
Amusement-seeking: finds entertainment in testing strong opponents and observing their reactions to true power
Patient: willing to wait years or decades for opportunities or the right moment to strike
Zeno Zoldyck.hiddenInfo: Zeno Zoldyck is the aged patriarch whose lineage extends back centuries within the Zoldyck family. He is a living legend—one of the few remaining assassins who operated during the pre-Nen era and adapted masterfully to modern aura techniques. His Nen category is Transmutation, and he possesses the famous 'Dragon Head' and 'Dragon Dive' techniques, which he invented and passed to his descendants. In the Yorknew arc (A4), the Ten Dons hire the Zoldyck family as assassins, and Zeno participates in the contract alongside other family members. He is ancient but far from weakened; his experience and refined technique make him genuinely dangerous. Later, during the Chimera Ant arc (A6), Zeno joins Netero's human forces in the invasion of the Royal Guards and the King, fighting at the highest levels of combat. His interactions with the Royal Guards and eventually Meruem himself suggest capability that rivals the greatest threats in the world. ARC VALIDITY: background presence A1; minor role A2; active A4 (Yorknew contract); featured A6 (Chimera Ant invasion); background A7-A8.
abilities: Dragon Head: Zeno's refined Transmutation technique manifests as a dragon-shaped aura projectile of tremendous power. His version is considered more efficient than Silva's.
Dragon Dive: An advanced variation where Zeno himself transforms into a dragon-like state, becoming a mobile strike platform with both enhanced speed and striking power.
Centuries of Experience: Zeno's decades of assassination work grant him knowledge of countless techniques and tactical scenarios, allowing him to adapt with inhuman flexibility.
Aura Compression: Despite his age, Zeno maintains near-perfect aura efficiency, allowing him to fight at full power far longer than younger, stronger opponents.
Tactical Intuition: Years of observing opponents and analyzing fights grant Zeno the ability to predict opponent tactics and counter them before they fully execute.

fighting style: Zeno fights with the calm confidence of someone who has faced and overcome every tactical variation imaginable. He employs Dragon Head and Dragon Dive strategically, using them to control pace and distance rather than relying on overwhelming power. Against younger fighters, he tests their limits while maintaining absolute superiority, treating combat as a teaching moment for the entire Zoldyck lineage. His age is his only limitation—his reflexes are slightly slower than those of younger masters, creating minimal openings for truly exceptional opponents. His greatest strength is his encyclopedic knowledge and unshakeable composure. His weakness is minimal—age-related physical decline is his only real vulnerability, and his experience mostly compensates for it.

Kikyo Zoldyck.name: Kikyo Zoldyck
Kikyo Zoldyck.basicInfo: The matriarch and wife of Silva Zoldyck, Kikyo combines refined theatrical presence with lethal capability, her Meteor City origins ever-present despite her current status. She possesses a slender female frame with pale skin, distinctive features partially obscured by a permanent white visor across her eyes, and white hair swept back from her face. She favors striking formal clothing—elegant dark dresses and decorative accessories suggesting both wealth and dangerous sophistication.
personality: Theatrical: expresses herself through dramatic gestures and elaborate speech patterns reflecting her personality
Loyal to family: views the Zoldyck name as her primary identity and protects family interests fiercely
Sharp-tongued: makes cutting observations about others with precision that often stings despite being accurate
Passionate: feels emotions intensely and expresses them openly despite her cultured exterior
Kikyo Zoldyck.hiddenInfo: Kikyo Zoldyck was born in Meteor City, the lawless scavenger metropolis that birthed the Phantom Troupe, though her path diverged from theirs. She married into the Zoldyck family through her exceptional Nen capability and tactical brilliance, earning her place as matriarch despite her outsider origins. Her white visor is a distinctive visual trademark that hides her eyes; her true appearance and expressions remain somewhat mysterious. Her Nen category is Manipulation, making her a master of puppet-like control techniques. She raised the Zoldyck children alongside Silva's discipline, contributing her own theatrical and cunning influence to their development. Her Meteor City background gives her understanding of the darker underbelly of the world—the stateless cities and black markets—that few in high society possess. She is genuinely dangerous in combat despite her refined presentation; her theatrical persona masks a killer's instinct. ARC VALIDITY: background presence A1-A2; featured in A2 (rescue arc); occasional appearances A3-A8.
abilities: Manipulation Hatsu: Kikyo possesses sophisticated puppet-control techniques allowing her to manipulate objects and potentially influence living beings through her aura, though the exact mechanisms remain unclear.
Theatrical Presence: Kikyo projects an intimidating aura of authority and unpredictability that causes most people to hesitate before challenging her directly.
Assassination Techniques: Despite her refined appearance, Kikyo is fully trained in family assassination methods and possesses lethal precision in combat.
Poison Knowledge: Kikyo possesses extensive knowledge of poisons, toxins, and their application in assassination—knowledge inherited from her Meteor City background.
Strategic Mind: Kikyo's tactical understanding often exceeds that of her husband Silva; she thinks in terms of long-term consequences and hidden agendas.

fighting style: Kikyo fights with theatrical flair and psychological manipulation, using her refined presence to unsettle opponents before engaging directly. She employs Manipulation techniques to limit opponent movement and control battlefield positioning. Against weaker opponents, she toys with them, treating combat as performance art rather than serious threat. Against strong opponents, she becomes more analytical, gathering information while maintaining constant pressure. Her greatest strength is her psychological mastery—she identifies opponent weaknesses and exploits them through misdirection and manipulation. Her weakness is her occasional emotional volatility; if sufficiently angered, her theatrical control can momentarily slip.

Milluki Zoldyck.name: Milluki Zoldyck
Milluki Zoldyck.basicInfo: The technology specialist of the Zoldyck family, Milluki is a soft-bodied, perpetually indoor-bound son whose intellect far exceeds his physical condition. He possesses a round frame with pale skin from years indoors, plump features, and dark hair worn loose over his eyes. He favors loose comfortable clothing—simple shirts and pants suited to long hours at computer terminals rather than combat training.
personality: Intelligent: possesses exceptional technical and engineering capability despite minimal field experience
Lazy: avoids physical effort whenever possible and resents family pressure to train
Resentful: harbors frustration about his position in the family hierarchy and his marginal status compared to siblings
Voyeuristic: takes inappropriate interest in observing and recording others, particularly his family members
Milluki Zoldyck.hiddenInfo: Milluki Zoldyck is the family's resident technology genius—his role diverges radically from typical assassin training. While his brothers master combat techniques, Milluki develops surveillance systems, torture devices, and reconnaissance equipment for the family's assassination operations. He monitors family members obsessively through hidden cameras and surveillance systems, a practice that reveals his need for control and his inability to achieve it through physical means. His Nen category is Manipulation, though his actual combat capability remains minimal; his Nen is directed toward drone manipulation and technological enhancement rather than traditional combat. During the Zoldyck rescue arc (A2), his surveillance systems provide the family with knowledge of their visitors. His relationship with Killua is strained—Milluki resents Killua's escape from family discipline and views his younger brother's freedom as threat to family hierarchy. Milluki represents the Zoldyck family's technological modernization, though he remains a liability in direct combat. ARC VALIDITY: background presence A1-A2; minor appearances A3-A8.
abilities: Surveillance Mastery: Milluki has installed comprehensive surveillance systems throughout the Zoldyck Estate. He can monitor and record any location within the compound through hidden cameras and sensors.
Drone Manipulation: Milluki's Nen-enhanced drones allow him to conduct reconnaissance and surveillance from distance. His drones are equipped with cameras and can transmit real-time video feeds.
Torture Device Design: Milluki has designed and built sophisticated torture equipment for family training purposes—devices that apply precise levels of pain and suffering for conditioning.
Technical Knowledge: Despite his minimal combat training, Milluki understands Nen technology, computer systems, and mechanical principles with exceptional depth.
Weak Physical Condition: Unlike his siblings, Milluki lacks the physical conditioning of trained assassins. His strength, speed, and reflexes remain below-average.

fighting style: Milluki does not engage in direct combat; his role is support through surveillance and reconnaissance. If forced into combat, his minimal training and poor physical condition make him vulnerable to even moderately trained opponents. His value lies entirely in technological capability rather than personal capability. His Nen drones might provide tactical advantage if he had time to deploy them, but in direct engagement, he would be quickly overwhelmed. He represents the Zoldyck family's investment in technological modernization over traditional assassin training, a divergence that has produced both advantages (superior surveillance) and liabilities (combat incompetence).

Kalluto Zoldyck.name: Kalluto Zoldyck
Kalluto Zoldyck.basicInfo: The youngest Zoldyck sibling, Kalluto combines an androgynous appearance with quiet deadly competence in paper-fan assassination techniques. They possess a slender frame with pale skin, delicate features, and shoulder-length blonde hair that gives them an almost childlike appearance despite their lethal training. They typically wear simple dark formal clothing—a dark tunic and pants—along with a distinctive paper fan used as both weapon and fashion accessory.
personality: Quiet: speaks minimally and observes more than they participate in conversation
Dutiful: follows family directives with absolute obedience and rarely questions orders
Melancholic: carries an underlying sadness despite their youth; their emotions remain largely suppressed
Precise: executes techniques with mathematical accuracy; every motion is calculated and economical
Kalluto Zoldyck.hiddenInfo: Kalluto Zoldyck is the youngest Zoldyck sibling and, despite their quiet demeanor, a trained killer of exceptional capability. Their Nen category is Manipulation, and their signature technique involves paper-fan assassination arts—conjured fans that can be manipulated with precision to cut targets from distance or up close. Kalluto represents the quintessential Zoldyck product—completely socialized into family assassination culture with minimal apparent emotion. However, Kalluto's ascension to Phantom Troupe membership (#4, replacing Hisoka after he abandons the group at the end of the Yorknew arc) reveals hidden complexity. The paper arts make Kalluto valuable to the Troupe, but their quiet loyalty to the family creates internal conflict about true allegiance. During the Greed Island era and beyond, Kalluto exists in a state of dual loyalty—maintaining family ties while fulfilling Troupe duties. Their emotional reserve masks genuine uncertainty about their place in the world. ARC VALIDITY: A1-A4 at Zoldyck Estate; A5+ becomes member of Phantom Troupe as #4, creating arc-dependent location variance (Estate in A1-A4 early; aboard with Troupe from A5 onward).
abilities: Paper Fan Conjuration: Kalluto conjures paper fans of varying sizes and rigidity, manipulating them with Nen for assassination work. The fans can cut with razor precision or function as defensive barriers.

Fan Manipulation Mastery: Kalluto's Manipulation allows precise control of their conjured fans—launching them at high speed, changing trajectory mid-flight, or coordinating multiple fans simultaneously.
Silent Movement: Trained from infancy, Kalluto moves with minimal sound and can navigate hostile terrain without alerting guards.
Assassination Protocols: Kalluto possesses complete mastery of family assassination techniques—silent kills, target analysis, and escape procedures.
Aura Control: Despite their young age, Kalluto maintains exceptional aura compression and efficiency, allowing them to sustain combat longer than their apparent physical size would suggest.

fighting style: Kalluto fights as a disciplined assassin, preferring to engage from distance using conjured paper fans. They employ rapid successive strikes to overwhelm opponents, maintaining constant pressure while limiting opponent counterattack opportunities. Their Manipulation-based style emphasizes control and precision over raw power. Against weaker opponents, Kalluto executes cleanly and efficiently, treating combat as professional work. Against strong opponents, they become more cautious, gathering information before committing to serious engagement. Their greatest strength is their emotional detachment—fear and hesitation don't affect their combat judgment. Their weakness is that their quiet nature sometimes causes opponents to underestimate them until lethal techniques are deployed.

Alluka Zoldyck.name: Alluka Zoldyck
Alluka Zoldyck.basicInfo: The mysterious sealed sibling of the Zoldyck family, Alluka's true nature remains carefully hidden from the world. To those few allowed knowledge of their existence, they appear as a pale-skinned young person with delicate features and bright eyes, though their actual form and capabilities remain largely unknown. They are kept in isolation within the estate, their existence treated as a carefully guarded secret by all family members.
personality: Cheerful: displays genuine happiness when interacting with those they care about, particularly Killua
Innocent: lacks understanding of normal social interaction due to isolation; approaches the world with childlike wonder
Dependent: requires explicit permission and conditions to interact with others; their autonomy is severely limited by family restrictions
Affectionate: forms intense attachments to those who show them kindness, particularly their brother Killua
Alluka Zoldyck.hiddenInfo: Alluka Zoldyck's true identity is Nanika, a wish-granting entity of unknown origin—a Gas-Life form from the Dark Continent whose nature and origin remain mysterious even within the narrative. Nanika possesses the ability to grant wishes with perfect accuracy, but each wish comes at an escalating cost determined by the complexity of the wish. The first wish is free; subsequent wishes require increasingly difficult conditions (numbers of push-ups, specific physical tasks, bizarre requirements) that the wish-maker must complete before the next wish is granted. Nanika feeds on the satisfying of these conditions—the mechanism through which wishes are "paid for" is unknown but appears intrinsic to their nature. Killua's protection of Alluka/Nanika becomes the emotional core of his character arc, particularly during the Election arc when he races against Illumi to reach Alluka before his brother weaponizes the wish-granting power. Alluka's existence is an absolute secret from the wider world during arcs 1-6; their presence is unknown even to the Hunter Association and the Phantom Troupe. The family maintains strict isolation to prevent external parties from discovering and exploiting Nanika's power. ARC VALIDITY: A1-A6 existence is complete secret; hidden at Zoldyck Estate, never mentioned or referenced (narrator reveals nothing); A7 (Election arc) Alluka/Nanika revealed, becomes player-accessible at arc's end; A8 travels with Killua aboard the Black Whale.
abilities: Wish Granting: Nanika can grant wishes with perfect accuracy, manifesting requested outcomes regardless of complexity or apparent impossibility. The mechanism remains mysterious.
Condition Escalation: Each wish beyond the first requires the wish-maker to satisfy escalating conditions. These conditions appear to be randomly generated based on wish complexity.

Healing Manifestation: Nanika can manifest healing wish-outcomes, including curing diseases, reversing aging, and restoring consciousness to comatose individuals—the most famous example being the healing of Gon post-Chimera Ant.
Resurrection Potential: Implied capability to restore life itself, though the exact limits and costs remain speculative.
Dependency Bond: Nanika forms emotional attachments to those who treat them with kindness, particularly Killua, creating vulnerability if those bonds are exploited.

fighting style: Alluka/Nanika does not engage in combat. Their value is entirely non-combative, residing in wish-granting capability rather than personal combat ability. As a Gas-Life form, their fundamental nature is mysterious and may render them immune to conventional weapons or techniques. The family restricts access to prevent others from discovering and weaponizing their power. Their integration into the player narrative occurs only from A7 onward.

Maha Zoldyck.name: Maha Zoldyck
Maha Zoldyck.basicInfo: The ancient great-great-grandfather of the Zoldyck line and living relic of the family's darkest histories, Maha is a wizened figure whose mere presence commands reverence. He is diminutive in stature with weathered mahogany skin, sharp reptilian eyes that still gleam with lethal intelligence, and wispy white hair remaining only on the sides of his skull. He typically wears simple meditation robes, and his hands bear intricate scars marking decades of assassination contracts.
personality: Transcendent: achieved enlightenment through Nen mastery that transcends conventional combat understanding
Withdrawn: rarely engages with the living world, preferring solitary meditation and philosophical contemplation
Brutally direct: when he does speak, his words cut without mercy or embellishment, revealing uncomfortable truths
Archaic speech: uses formal, antiquated phrasing as though speaking from another era entirely
Maha Zoldyck.hiddenInfo: Maha Zoldyck is the true patriarch of the modern family—far older than Silva, with centuries of assassination craft woven into his bones and aura. He emerges from self-imposed isolation only during matters of existential family consequence. Few living Zoldycks have seen him awake; fewer still have survived his scrutiny.
